project.name: legal-tech-debt
project.north_star: Build inspectable legal tech debt probes that turn insurance legal and regulatory text into source-traceable evidence, candidate smells, findings, and human-reviewable reports.

startup_order: CLAUDE_CONSTRAINTS.md first when the active agent is Claude Code
tool-specific entry file: AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, or .github/copilot-instructions.md
active sandbox README, roadmap, ADRs, and latest handoff

current_focus.run_summary: Sandbox 002 closed with 28 sources, 353 nodes, 121 candidate evidence items, 39 Stage 003 retrieval bundles, and 23 detector findings after Stage 002 artifact contract repair

active_scope: Findings triage and intelligence over Sandbox 002 outputs
out_of_scope_by_default: Personal auto, no-fault, PIP, and broad claims-platform work
Production infrastructure, services, databases, queues, schedulers, Docker, and deployment scaffolding
Vector infrastructure until retrieval evaluation earns it
implementation_preferences: Prefer small readable local Python over abstractions or infrastructure.
Prefer deterministic JSON/JSONL/CSV/Markdown artifacts with schemas where downstream stages consume them.
Preserve provenance, source text, source_type, run_id, schema_version, created_at, and stable IDs.
Separate candidate evidence, detector findings, LLM annotations, and reviewer reports.
Use source-type-aware heuristics; regulatory documents and carrier filings need different false-positive handling.
Run focused validation and report concrete counts, run IDs, and unvalidated gaps.
